$comment: The one place the character lives. The frontend (avatar, still photo, UI copy) and the backend (voice, prompt, greeting, tests) both read this file. To change the character, edit character/name/voices and add the still photo the idle dock shows at frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp; roles is the label under the name for each of the agent's jobs (by landing page). gender (female/male) is how the character speaks of itself: the prompt tells the model to use matching Hindi verb forms, and the written Hindi lines in backend/lines.py are in the feminine first person (switch them for a male character). To add a language, add it to languages and voices (and give the brain written lines for it in backend/lines.py).
name: Riya
